input.rationale:
The effects-of-termination provision (Section 4(c), p0019–p0022) only requires Kubient to cease the Services, revokes the licence, and lets each party "return or destroy" the other's Confidential Information at its own election. There is no obligation to return or export our data in a usable format, no transition assistance period, and no deletion certification; the terms "Customer Data", "export" and "transition" appear nowhere in the Agreement. That fails even the fallback position (90 days of assistance plus a 30-day data export), and the Recipient's unilateral right to destroy our information edges toward the walk-away outcome. We therefore insert the preferred exit provision — up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable return/export within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter — as a new subparagraph (v) of Section 4(c), offering 90 days of assistance as a fallback.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.82

ops.text: (v) upon Customer's request, Kubient shall (A) provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Kubient's then-current rates; (B) within thirty (30) days of such request, return or make available for export all Requests, Content and other Customer data in Kubient's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (C) thereafter delete such data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4(c) ends the Services and permits destruction of Confidential Information without any obligation to give our data back or help us migrate, so we have added a standard exit provision: up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return or export of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is difficult, we can accept ninety (90) days of assistance provided the 30-day export and deletion certificate remain.
proposal.summary: Insert transition-assistance and data-return obligation into the effects-of-termination list.
